boardOfficials.name: RAVEENDRA SIRIWARDENE
boardOfficials.bio:
Having over 25 years managerial experience as an HR professional in leading Multinationals and Public Listed Companies in Sri Lanka, am presently serving as the General Manager HR and Administration at United Motors Lanka PLC where he has served for 19 years. He holds a B. Sc. HRM (Sp.) degree from University of Sri Jayawardhanapura, a member of the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management ans has attended various local and overseas executive training programs including the prestigious Harvard Business School. 

Being a passionate wildlife photographer and researcher he has co-authored a coffee table book AVIUM “an endless journey through Sri Lankan wilds” in 2016 with Milinda Wattegedara and Sadeepa Gunawardene. Being a member of Leopard diary team for more than a decade has contributed to leopard identification projects in Yala and Kumana national parks. He is one of the founder member of Yala leopard centre and Yala leopard research team contributing to leopard researches published in international journals. Raveendra is an active member of Wild tuskers Sri Lanka and a fiunder member of Wild Srilanka community and serving as the President in this financial year.

boardOfficials.name: BANU MAPALAGAMA
boardOfficials.bio:
Bhanu’s journey behind the lens began in 2004, within the walls of Ananda College, Colombo. As President of the School Photographic Society from 2006 to 2007, he led the team to new heights in school photography. While his profession lies in banking, his true calling has always been wildlife photography.

In 2012, he began to dedicate himself to wildlife photography, driven by a deep desire to contribute to the conservation of Sri Lanka’s unique biodiversity. His commitment is not only artistic but also academic, as reflected in his Advanced Certificate in Wildlife Conservation and Management from the Open University of Sri Lanka (OUSL).

His work has been recognized nationally with merit awards at the State Awards Ceremony in both 2016 and 2017. Internationally, his photographs have been represented and shortlisted in prestigious competitions such as The Sanctuary Wildlife Photography Awards and the Siena International Photo Awards.

Through his photography, he seeks to tell the stories of the natural world and inspire others to embrace the mission of wildlife conservation.

boardOfficials.name: THARINDU SENDANAYAKE
boardOfficials.bio: By profession, Tharindu delves into the world of data analysis, uncovering insights and patterns. When he's not crunching numbers, he's chasing moments in the wild with his camera, capturing the breathtaking beauty of nature through wildlife photography. This dual passion for analyzing information and preserving the wonders of the natural world keeps him curious and inspired every day. Since embarking on his wildlife photography journey in 2018, he has found boundless inspiration in capturing the untamed beauty of nature. With a special fascination for leopards and majestic tuskers, he has dedicated his lens to preserving their grace and magnificence. Alongside these passions, he immerses himself in the art of bird photography, seeking to freeze moments of avian splendor in their natural habitats. Each click of the shutter allows him to share the awe-inspiring stories of these remarkable creatures through his lens.

boardOfficials.name: ISURU PRAVEEN RANASINGHE
boardOfficials.bio:
Isuru, an internationally acclaimed wildlife photographer and co-founder of the Wild Sri Lanka group, stands as a distinguished figure in the realm of nature photography. Commencing his photographic journey in 2012, Isuru has garnered numerous accolades, including state awards, FIAP, PSA, and GPU gold medals, with more than 800 international acceptances spanning across 40+ countries. Beyond his remarkable achievements, Isuru is committed to nurturing the next generation of photographers through engaging photography lectures and wildlife workshops. As the owner of IK Photography & Cinematography, he continues his career as a professional wedding and event photographer. Driven by his profound love for nature, he actively maintains his passion for wildlife photography, aspiring to capture the beauty of the natural world and inspire others along the way. He is an Admin of Kumana Leopard diary. 

 He is also organizing guided wildlife tours across all the major national parks in Sri Lanka, offering visitors the chance to experience the country’s rich biodiversity. Through these tours, he shares his deep knowledge of wildlife, conservation, and local ecosystems with both local and foreign visitors, creating an educational and memorable experience.

boardOfficials.name: ASHANE MARASINGHE
boardOfficials.bio:
Ashane Marasinghe is an internationally recognized wildlife photographer, jury member, and seasoned professional with a background as a Cargo Sales Supervisor in the international airline industry. He is currently based in Finland. His passion for photography began in 2013, and in 2014 he earned a Diploma in Advanced Photography from the National Association of Photographers, Sri Lanka (NAPSL).

 Over the years, Ashane has earned numerous international awards and distinctions, affirming his talent and dedication to the art of photography. His accolades include:EFIAP/b (Excellence FIAP, Bronze) – International Federation of Photographic Art, France (2021),GPU Crown 02 – Global Photographic Union, Greece (2020) cMOL – Master of Light, Canada (2019) 

His work has been recognized in prestigious competitions such as Big Picture Natural World Photography Competition, Nature’s Best Photography International Awards, Siena Awards, DJ Memorial Photography Competition, Bird Photographer of the Year, Magical Nature – Nature Photography of the Year, Nature InFocus, Biodiversity Photography Contest, Black and White Photo Contest, and Earth Photo and PSA 2020 Image of the Year-Nature Division.

 Beyond competitions, Ashane’s photography has been showcased in leading international publications, including GEO Magazine (Germany), VIEW Magazine (Germany), and National Geographic (Italy).

boardOfficials.name: NAMAL HERATH
boardOfficials.bio: Namal is a dedicated member of the Wild Sri Lanka team, contributing their expertise and passion for wildlife photography and conservation. With a commitment to preserving Sri Lanka's natural heritage, they work tirelessly to promote awareness and appreciation for the country's diverse wildlife.

boardOfficials.name: SADEEPA GUNAWARDANA
boardOfficials.bio:
He is a marketer by profession, but his heart finds its true rhythm in the wild. In moments of stillness away from work, he seeks the untamed beauty of nature. Recently, together with two close colleagues, he had the privilege of publishing a coffee table book titled Avium. To their delight, it resonated deeply with readers across Sri Lanka, with more than 2,000 copies finding homes. Now, with renewed passion, he and his team are preparing for their next book, which they aim to release before the end of 2027.

For him, photography is far more than an art form — it is a powerful instrument for conservation. When used with purpose, it can open eyes, stir hearts, and inspire action. His greatest ambition is to safeguard the wonders of nature and its magnificent wildlife through the lens, preserving them as a legacy for generations yet to come.

He firmly believes that the key lies in the hands of the young. By nurturing their love and respect for nature, he hopes to plant the seeds of guardianship, ensuring they grow into protectors of the world we all share.

boardOfficials.name: MITHUN SENANAYAKE
boardOfficials.bio:
Photography is not his profession, but his passion. His love for wildlife photography began over 11 years ago when he joined the Young Zoologists’ Association of Sri Lanka. From there, his connection with nature and conservation grew, becoming an integral part of his life. His main areas of interest are birding and mammals.

A special milestone in his journey came in 2018, when he was elected to the Wild Sri Lanka Admin Panel. That same year, he participated in his very first competition — the State Festival of Photography Sri Lanka — where he earned 2nd place and a merit certificate in the Nature category.

He believes that wildlife photography must serve as a powerful tool to build awareness about animals and nature, while also acting as a vital method of conservation.

boardOfficials.name: PASAN SENEVIRATHNE
boardOfficials.bio: Pasan has been an experienced wildlife photographer in Sri Lanka since 2013. By profession, he is a graphic designer and a photographer.

boardOfficials.name: CHAMAL JAYASEKARA
boardOfficials.bio:
He is a Project Manager with a background in hotel and resort development, but his true passion lies in the world of travel, adventure, and photography. Since picking up a digital camera in 2017, his work has been recognized with multiple honors, including wins at the Nethadara Photography Competition 2018, NPASL Nature Category 2024, and Sobaseya 2024. He has also received merit awards from Wild Sri Lanka Photographer of the Year (WSLPOY) 2018 and the Ceylon Photography Awards 2021.

Beyond accolades, he is deeply committed to using his lens as a tool for wildlife conservation. He shares his knowledge and passion through workshops and webinars, with a strong focus on promoting ethical photography practices.

boardOfficials.name: LAKSHITHA KARUNARATHNE
boardOfficials.bio: Lakshitha is an internationally acclaimed wildlife photographer and co-founder of the Wild Sri Lanka group. A recipient of the Fellowship of The Royal Photographic Society (FRPS). Notable accolades include the Grand Prize in Nature's Best Photography 2017 USA, the second prize in Sanctuary Wildlife Photography Awards 2018, and the prestigious title of Africa’s Photographer of the Year 2018, etc. Inspired by Sir David Attenborough, Lakshitha's fascination with nature and wildlife started early, culminating in a career that combines his profession in tea tasting with his true passion for exploring the wilderness. His photographic journeys across Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Arctic reflect a profound commitment to capturing the essence of nature. Lakshitha believes in the transformative power of his art to raise conservation awareness and inspire a deeper connection with the natural world.

boardOfficials.name: MILINDA WATTEGEDARA
boardOfficials.bio: Milinda is an experienced wildlife photographer and researcher on leopards in Sri Lanka. He is the co-founder of the Yala Leopard Diary, Wild Tuskers of Sri Lanka, the Yala Leopard Centre in Yala National Park, and the Hill Country Leopard Conservation Initiative. Additionally, Milinda is a co-author of the Yala Leopard Identification Guide, the Kalawewa Tusker Identification Guide, and Avium. His involvement in the Leopard Research Team, which pioneered the Multipoint Leopard Identification method, stands as a momentous achievement. This innovative identification technique ensures accurate leopard identification, eliminating the overestimation of leopard populations in Sri Lanka. Milinda's dedication to wildlife photography has earned him prestigious awards, including the Winner of the 2017 Sanctuary Asia Call of the Wildlife Photography Awards, a Special Mention in 2016, Sanctuary Asia Call of the Wildlife Photography Awards, and the Best of the Show 2016 and Best Wildlife Picture 2016 from the Photographic Society of Sri Lanka.

moderaTeam.name: Ishara Mewan Perera
moderaTeam.bio: Ishara is a young wildlife photographer from Colombo, Sri Lanka, whose passion for nature began at an early age. Fascinated by animals and ecosystems since childhood, Ishara has developed a keen eye for capturing the untamed beauty of Sri Lanka’s wilderness. With experience photographing in iconic national parks like Yala and Wilpattu, Ishara’s work reflects both technical skill and a deep emotional connection to the wild.
